tasks.title: Gate Tooling and Frontend Build Verification

features.title: Frontend dependency installation and production build
done_when: cd fe && npm install succeeds cleanly without error
cd fe && npm run build produces fe/dist/ and exits with code 0

features.title: Frontend gate scripts for typecheck, unit testing, and e2e testing
done_when: cd fe && npm run typecheck executes tsc --noEmit and exits with code 0
cd fe && npm test executes Vitest unit tests and exits with code 0
cd fe && npm run test:e2e executes Playwright test runner and exits with code 0

features.title: Backend gate test suite runner
done_when: bash be/tests/run_tests.sh executes and exits with code 0

Test suite validates all constraints in AGENTS.md section 3 (auth, WIP limits on ongoing cards only, completed cards auto-finishing tasks, 409 on deleting non-empty cards without force, linked boards, and ownership)

tasks.title: Design System Tokens, Themes, and In-App Modal System

features.title: Design system tokens and theme architecture
done_when: Old themes in themes.js and themes.css are replaced with stone-light and forest-dark tokens matching DESIGN_SYSTEM.md
CSS variables for colors, typography, spacing, radii, and shadows are defined in plain CSS
Theme applies on application load without a flash of unstyled theme

features.title: Reusable accessible in-app modal system
done_when: Modal system implements message, confirm, prompt, and task detail dialog variants
Modals have role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and trap keyboard focus
Escape key closes active modal and returns focus to the triggering element
Clicking outside backdrop cancels dialog without triggering destructive actions
Modal dialog is usable and responsive at phone (375px) and desktop (1280px) widths

features.title: Elimination of native browser dialogs in existing components
done_when: no alert(/confirm(/prompt( remains in any file in fe/src
Board deletion, card deletion, group creation, board creation, and card creation use in-app modals
Full gate passes
